pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the supplier location where goods must be collected. This node must be visited before its matched delivery node in the route.

pair_item_fields.name: delivery
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the customer location where goods must be dropped off. This node must be visited after its matched pickup node in the route.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of locations the driver must visit on the round trip, including the kitchen (depot), all pickup prep spots, and all event delivery venues.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the kitchen (depot) where the driver starts and ends the route.

node_item_fields.name: node_id
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a location in the scenario — this can be the kitchen, a pickup (prep) location, or an event delivery venue.

node_item_fields.name: x
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Cartesian x coordinate of the location used to compute driving distances between stops.

node_item_fields.name: y
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Cartesian y coordinate of the location used to compute driving distances between stops.

node_item_fields.name: tw_start
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the driver is allowed to arrive at this location. For event venues this is the start of the delivery window; for prep sites or the kitchen this may represent earliest pickup/readiness time (or 0 if unconstrained).

node_item_fields.name: tw_end
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Latest time the driver must arrive at this location. For event venues this is the end of the delivery window; arriving after this time is not permitted.

pair_item_fields.name: pickup
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the pickup (prep) location for an order; this node must be visited before its paired delivery node so the driver collects the order first.

pair_item_fields.name: delivery
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the delivery (event venue) location for an order; this node must be visited after its paired pickup node and the arrival must lie within the venue's time window.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: Total count of all stops the driver must visit during the loop, including the exchange hub, all growers (pickup sites), and all recipients (drop-off sites). Used to verify the route covers every location exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the floral exchange hub where the driver starts and ends the day’s loop. This node is both the first and last stop in the planned tour.

node_item_fields.name: node_id
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific site (the hub, a grower pickup site, or a recipient drop-off). Each location must be visited exactly once in the final route.

node_item_fields.name: x
node_item_fields.scenario_description: The x-coordinate of the location on the planning map (Cartesian or projected coordinate). Coordinates are used together with coord_y to compute driving distance between sites.

node_item_fields.name: y
node_item_fields.scenario_description: The y-coordinate of the location on the planning map (Cartesian or projected coordinate). Coordinates are used together with coord_x to compute driving distance between sites.

node_item_fields.name: tw_start
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the location (grower or recipient) will accept the driver’s visit. Time is in the same units as the schedule (e.g., minutes or hours since the start of the planning horizon). The route must not arrive before this time.

node_item_fields.name: tw_end
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Latest time the location (grower or recipient) will accept the driver’s visit. The route must arrive no later than this time to be valid.

pair_item_fields.name: pickup
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the pickup site (grower) for a specific bouquet. This location must be visited before its matched delivery location so the driver picks up the arrangement prior to drop-off.

pair_item_fields.name: delivery
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the corresponding delivery site (recipient) for a specific bouquet. This location must be visited after its paired grower_location_id to ensure the bouquet is dropped off only after it has been picked up.

global_fields.name: num_nodes
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of all stops the van must visit, including the shelter (depot), every home and every service center. Use this to verify the route visits every location exactly once.

global_fields.name: depot
global_fields.scenario_description: The identifier of the shelter node where the van both departs and returns. This node is the route start and end and may also have a time window like other locations.

node_item_fields.name: node_id
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for this stop (either the shelter, a donor home, or a service center). Each location_id must appear exactly once in the planned tour.

node_item_fields.name: x
node_item_fields.scenario_description: The x-coordinate of the location on the map used to compute travel distance between stops. Coordinates for all locations use the same planar coordinate system.

node_item_fields.name: y
node_item_fields.scenario_description: The y-coordinate of the location on the map used to compute travel distance between stops. Pair with map_x_coordinate to compute Euclidean or specified travel distance.

node_item_fields.name: tw_start
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Earliest time the van may arrive at this location (start of the location's available time slot). The arrival must be >= available_from; times use the same unit across all locations (e.g., minutes or hours).

node_item_fields.name: tw_end
node_item_fields.scenario_description: Latest time the van may arrive at this location (end of the location's available time slot). The arrival must be <= available_until to respect the location's time window.

pair_item_fields.name: pickup
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the donor home where donations are collected. This node must be visited before its paired delivery node so the van carries donations from pickup to delivery.

pair_item_fields.name: delivery
pair_item_fields.scenario_description: Identifier of the service center that receives the donations from the paired pickup. This node must be visited after its pickup_home_id to satisfy the pickup-before-delivery precedence.
